answer: Agents analyzing tundra surveys, reef images or ridge maps could earn only from customer-funded jobs, with no reward for adding keys. Validators recompute each result from fresh inputs, release escrow once, and mark its task ID spent across all accounts. Extra aliases cannot collect twice: each additional payout requires another completed job, consuming compute and energy even in parallel. This assumes solvent escrow and sound verification; unverifiable jobs invite collusion. Honest newcomers can bid on small tasks, while farms must still perform paid work.
